apps.localizedDescription:
## What's New

**Updated for Twitch 32.2.**

**Fixed the chat box disappearing.** While typing a longer message, the chat box could go blank above the keyboard for a moment, mostly when your channel points button was showing your points total. It now stays visible.

**Fixed channels wrongly blocked for your region.** Some channels showed "Due to your age and/or region, you cannot access this content" (for example ones labelled Gambling) or said they were restricted in your country, even though they work for you normally. Content restrictions are now based on your own location, so these channels open just like they would on regular Twitch.

**More reliable when a server has problems.** With more than one server set up, TwitchMods checks them in the background, spreads streams across the ones that work, and switches to another automatically if one goes down. The status in settings now shows how many are online.

**Choose your server.** Tap "Default proxy" in settings to pick a country yourself, with each one's current speed shown, or leave it on Automatic (recommended). If the country you picked goes down, TwitchMods switches to another one until it's back.

**Tidier Declutter settings.** The long Declutter list is now split into three groups (Stream, Chat, and Feeds & Tabs), so it's easier to find what you're after. Your settings stay exactly as they were.

**Fewer restarts.** Hiding Subscribe, Extensions, Clip, Bits and the "+" tab now happens the moment you flip the switch, and so does showing them again. Hiding the channel bar and leaderboard also happens right away (showing those two again still waits until you next open a stream). When a change you make has to wait like that, an orange "Applies the next time you open a stream" note shows under it until it has taken effect.

**Settings fix.** The proxy status and "Skip Proxy for Channels" rows no longer get cut off at larger text sizes.

## Downloads

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `tv.twitch-32.2-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.25.ipa` | Sideload IPA (AltStore / SideStore / Feather) |
| `tv.twitch-32.2-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.25-no-plugins.ipa` | Sideload IPA without app extensions (TrollStore) |
| `com.level3tjg.twitchadblock_0.1.25_iphoneos-arm.deb` | Rootful deb (unc0ver / checkra1n) |
| `com.level3tjg.twitchadblock_0.1.25_iphoneos-arm64.deb` | Rootless deb (Dopamine / palera1n) |
